title: FX lock file, fx.lock (fx: lock/v1)
description: The source digest behind each versioned project node type (identity.md §6), and behind each versioned project adapter the project declares (adapters.md §9). Planning refuses a type, or a route served by an adapter, whose source no longer matches its entry. A versioned type or adapter with no entry plans normally, and `grida-fx lock --check` reports it as unlocked. Written by `grida-fx lock`; commit it.

nodes.description: `<path>#<attr>@<version>` to `digest(source)`. `<path>` is POSIX, relative to the project root, without `./`.

adapters.description: `<path>#<attribute>@<version>` of each versioned adapter the project declares (providers.md section 1) to `digest(source)`, its source closure hashed as a node type's with no resources. Written only when there is one.
